This is a first-price sealed-bid auction with a twist: the winner pays the second-highest bid. This is essentially a Vickrey auction (second-price auction). In a Vickrey auction, the dominant strategy is to bid your true value. This is because bidding less risks losing to a bid lower than your value, and bidding more risks winning and paying more than your value. Since this is the first round and there's no history, I'll stick to the dominant strategy.
